title: Most news feeds are broken because they treat everyone like the same person.
body:
We have all been there. You click on one article about a tech launch, and suddenly your entire feed is nothing but tech press releases for the next three weeks. It is not helpful. It is just noise.

At Headlinne, we realized that personalization should not be about predicting what you might click on next. It should be about understanding the topics you actually value. A good recommendation engine does not just look at your clicks. It looks at the depth of your interest.

When we built our system, we focused on nuance. If you read a piece about renewable energy, the engine should not just dump every article with the word 'energy' in the headline onto your screen. It should learn whether you care about the policy side, the investment angle, or the consumer technology behind it.

True personalization happens when the app gets quieter, not louder. It learns to filter out the fluff so you can focus on the stories that actually inform your day.
cta: You can see how we are building a better way to read at HEADLINNE.com.
